title: How will Trump’s visit hurt travel in city? Syracuse police won’t say what roads will close
summary: Syracuse Police Department declined to publicly disclose road closure details ahead of President Trump's campaign event scheduled for Friday, October 8, 2026. The lack of transparency regarding traffic impact and route changes has left Central New Yorkers without advance notice needed for travel planning, raising concerns about public communication protocols during high-profile events.
